title: Juice shop owner behind ₹6,000-crore Mahadev betting app scam brought back to India | Betting racket was operated from outside India | Inshorts
text:
Juice shop owner behind ₹6,000-crore Mahadev betting app scam brought back to India 
 Menu English हिन्दी Categories For the best experience use inshorts app on your smartphone Juice shop owner behind ₹6,000-crore Mahadev betting app scam brought back to India
 short by Ashley Paul / 02:29 pm on Sunday, 1 November, 2026 Saurabh Chandrakar, the man behind the ₹6,000-crore Mahadev betting app case, has been extradited to India from Oman. The Royal Oman Police traced and arrested Chandrakar, who used to work as a juice shop owner, based on an Interpol Red Corner Notice. A CBI investigation had found that the betting app case was among India's largest illegal online betting syndicates. read more at Hindustan Times Inshorts Pte. Ltd.
